info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Collateral Administration By Param1-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed collateral administration data based on specific parameters. It serves financial institutions and administrators by providing information necessary for effective collateral allocation management. Key consumers of this API include banking professionals and compliance officers who need to access collateral data for auditing and reporting purposes. By utilizing this endpoint, users can ensure accurate monitoring and management of collateral assets.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific collateral allocation identified by its unique ID. This operation is useful for examining the specifics of a collateral allocation within the collateral management system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve data related to collateral allocation management operations for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. The structure of the request body follows the schema defined for this operation, ensuring that all required parameters are supplied in the correct format.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the expected data.
